say:1:1411413001:1.text: Fortunately, there were a few minor injuries. Most people were just startled.
say:1:1411413001:1.source_cn: 还好还好，没有重伤，只有几个轻伤的，大部分人只是被吓了一跳。

say:2:1411413002:1.text: And the mine didn't collapse. Only some loose rocks came down.
say:2:1411413002:1.source_cn: 矿洞也几乎完好无损，最多就是有一点点碎石。

say:3:1411413003:1.text: Still, we'll call a temporary stop to work, just in case.
say:3:1411413003:1.source_cn: 以防万一，我已经通知停工了。

say:5:1411413004:1.text: Yes, losing one or two days isn't going to matter in the grand scheme of things. Safety always comes first.
say:5:1411413004:1.source_cn: 嗯，不差这么一两天的工期，安全生产才是第一位。

say:6:1411413005:1.text: But the quaking was severe just now... and that dwarf said he heard a strange rumbling noise.
say:6:1411413005:1.source_cn: 只不过，刚刚摇晃得那么严重，又有人说听到下方轰隆作响……

choice_prompt:7:1411413005.text: But the quaking was severe just now... and that dwarf said he heard a strange rumbling noise.
choice_prompt:7:1411413005.source_cn: 只不过，刚刚摇晃得那么严重，又有人说听到下方轰隆作响……

say:8:1411413006:1.text: Yes, if the tremors here were so strong, Sal'thorin may be even more affected.
say:8:1411413006:1.source_cn: 是，我们在上方震感都这么强烈，萨洛克兰矿区恐怕受影响更严重。
say:8:1411413006:1.male: Yes, if the tremors here were so strong, Sal'thorin may be even more affected.
say:8:1411413006:1.female: Yes, if the tremors here were so strong, Sal'thorin may be even more affected.

say:9:1411413008:1.text: I have to go down and notify everyone in the Sal'thorin mines to stop work as well.
say:9:1411413008:1.source_cn: 就算没问题，已经地震了，我也得下去通知下下面一起停工。

say:10:1411413009:1.text: I'll come with you. I want to check out the underground mines with my own eyes.
say:10:1411413009:1.source_cn: 那我们就一起进去看看情况吧，我正好也可以亲眼目睹一下地...

say:11:1411413010:1.text: If anything's wrong, I'll help however I can.
say:11:1411413010:1.source_cn: 万一有什么问题，我这边提供支援也能更及时和准确。

choice_prompt:12:1411413010.text: If anything's wrong, I'll help however I can.
choice_prompt:12:1411413010.source_cn: 万一有什么问题，我这边提供支援也能更及时和准确。

say:13:1411413011:1.text: It doesn't always have to be money and business, Merlin. Besides, Celestials don't actually need money and gold in their everyday lives.
say:13:1411413011:1.source_cn: 我可不是光投资和做生意啊，梅林。再说，半神的日常生活也...
say:13:1411413011:1.male: It doesn't always have to be money and business, Merlin. Besides, Celestials don't actually need money and gold in their everyday lives.
say:13:1411413011:1.female: It doesn't always have to be money and business, Merlin. Besides, Celestials don't actually need money and gold in their everyday lives.

say:14:1411413012:1.text: If you go back to the Empire and ask, you'll find out that Baelran the philanthropist is more famous than Baelran the investor.
say:14:1411413012:1.source_cn: 你如果回耀光帝国打听下，就会知道“好心人巴赫朗”的称号...
say:14:1411413012:1.male: If you go back to the Empire and ask, you'll find out that Baelran the philanthropist is more famous than Baelran the investor.
say:14:1411413012:1.female: If you go back to the Empire and ask, you'll find out that Baelran the philanthropist is more famous than Baelran the investor.

say:16:1411413013:1.text: More like Baelran the gullible squanderer...
say:16:1411413013:1.source_cn: 事实上，很多时候是“冤大头巴赫朗”。

say:17:1411413014:1.text: In fact, his daily life is wasteful and extravagant. He just earns more than he uses.
say:17:1411413014:1.source_cn: 而且，巴赫朗的日常生活很奢华，只是他赚得更多。

say:18:1411413015:1.text: But his random kindness does not make up for the fact that he's always on the losing end...
say:18:1411413015:1.source_cn: 但是，巴赫朗，随手给予的善意是无法弥补缺位的损失的。

say:19:1411413016:1.text: Well, he knows this but does it anyway.
say:19:1411413016:1.source_cn: 你深知这一点，却仍然明知故犯。

say:20:1411413017:1.text: Yeah, so there's no point in trying to save him money. If you need gold, just ask him.
say:20:1411413017:1.source_cn: 所以，不用替他省钱，如果有需要的话，尽管开口吧。
say:20:1411413017:1.male: Yeah, so there's no point in trying to save him money. If you need gold, just ask him.
say:20:1411413017:1.female: Yeah, so there's no point in trying to save him money. If you need gold, just ask him.

say:21:1411413018:1.text: At least using his fortune to help others is something a Celestial would do...
say:21:1411413018:1.source_cn: 至少用自己的收入帮助他人，多少还像点半神的样子。

say:23:1411413019:0.text: I could do without the commentary... However, as you said, I am willing to provide financial support for what happened here.
say:23:1411413019:0.source_cn: 你们两个真是……好吧，正如你们所说，我随时愿意为可能发...

say:25:1411413020:0.text: So, no matter what happens, don't hesitate to ask me for help. Alright, Zanie?
say:25:1411413020:0.source_cn: 所以，无论遇到什么困难，都请告诉我，好吗，祖娅？

say:26:1411413021:0.text: I can provide you with anything you need.
say:26:1411413021:0.source_cn: 不用担心，我会为你提供所需要的一切。

choice_prompt:27:1411413021.text: I can provide you with anything you need.
choice_prompt:27:1411413021.source_cn: 不用担心，我会为你提供所需要的一切。

say:28:1411413022:0.text: Thank you. Let's hurry below. We'll check the tunnels and then head to Sal'thorin.
say:28:1411413022:0.source_cn: 那太好了，我们赶紧下去，这次我们要直奔矿区，下次再带你...

choice:27:0:1.text: He said that with a straight face...
choice:27:0:1.male: He said that with a straight face...
choice:27:0:1.female: He said that with a straight face...

choice:7:0:1.text: Are you worried about what's below?
choice:7:0:1.male: Are you worried about what's below?
choice:7:0:1.female: Are you worried about what's below?

say:30:1411413007:1.text: Yes, I suspect so. It didn't affect us much, but the tremors here were very strong. No telling what it did to Sal'thorin.
say:30:1411413007:1.source_cn: 按常理来说是的，虽然我们上面没受什么影响，但这么强烈的...
say:30:1411413007:1.male: Yes, I suspect so. It didn't affect us much, but the tremors here were very strong. No telling what it did to Sal'thorin.
say:30:1411413007:1.female: Yes, I suspect so. It didn't affect us much, but the tremors here were very strong. No telling what it did to Sal'thorin.

choice:7:1:2.text: Could be more serious down there...
choice:7:1:2.male: Could be more serious down there...
choice:7:1:2.female: Could be more serious down there...
